svg.title: Do the internal province seams persist across seasons?
svg.desc: Four matched Oceanic Mollweide panels color sampled internal province seams by DJF, MAM, JJA, and SON direction similarity. None of the sampled seams remains opposed in all four seasons. No split is proposed.
svg.metadata: OSCAR source artifact SHA-256 bb1aa2d76de6bc6438114561f8d2401b2c88f24c5b00a521bbf324d354c9ec15; Natural Earth commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19, SHA-256 9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9. Province signatures are unweighted means of supported coarse display-grid cells. Sampled adjacency uses four-neighbor display-grid contacts and is not validated province geometry, boundary exchange, area-weighted transport, or a split instruction.
